notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
openssl s_client against port 995 (POP3S) for interactive POP3 session over TLS. POP3 is simpler than IMAP — only list, retrieve, delete. Downloads messages to local storage. IMAP preferred for richer access but POP3 used when only that protocol is available.

=== POP3 COMMANDS ===
USER username → identify user
PASS password → authenticate
LIST → list messages with sizes
RETR 1 → retrieve first message
DELE 1 → delete (avoid in assessments)
QUIT → close session
